title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
summary: On the evening of 9 November 1989, Politburo member Günter Schabowski announced new East German travel rules at a press conference. Because of a mix-up over when they took effect, East Berliners crowded the border crossings and pressed guards to apply them at once. Bornholmer Straße opened first, and shortly after midnight all crossings were open.

uncertainty.note: Evening of 9 November; sources say all crossings were open shortly after midnight.
